answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable bond and solve a fresh cipher puzzle tied to its public key each epoch. A sybil operator must fund a separate bond and pay the compute cost per identity, so the cost grows linearly with each fake account while the delta between one honest identity and a hundred fakes stays crystal clear in the ledger: honest agents keep one bond, attackers bleed funds on every copy. Slashing the bond on proven duplication makes the attack unprofitable.
